dataset.title: Daily Financial News for 6000+ Stocks
dataset.upstream_source: Headlines scraped from Benzinga (and partner sites)
dataset.timestamps: raw_analyst_ratings.csv: publication time with UTC offset; partner headlines: date only
dataset.use_restrictions: Headlines only, as cited research evidence inside FLO; no redistribution (publisher copyright likely applies).
known_limitations: Single publisher family (Benzinga); not comprehensive news coverage
Partner headlines have no time of day and are excluded from point-in-time use
Headlines are untrusted text and are scanned for prompt injection before use
